❓ Help

Header buttons

⚙️Open Settings
0 – 0Tap to edit score manually
🩺Injury pause — freezes all timers
📹Open / close camera panel
☰Toggle drag-to-reorder mode

Player dot colours

🟡 YellowCurrent goalkeeper
🟢 GreenOn field
🔴 RedComing off next sub
🔵 BlueComing on next sub

Player row — shows name, status, field timer, and ⚽ goal button (on-field players only). Tap ⚽ to log a goal (also adds 1 to team score).

Tap the keeper row to immediately swap to any other player.

Drag mode (☰) — shows ≡ handles on each row. Touch and drag to reorder players.

Game timer (bottom right) — counts down each half. Tap to start/pause. Starting game timer also starts sub timer.

Sub timer (bottom left) — counts down to next substitution. Turns red at 30 seconds. Can be paused independently.

Swap button (centre) — pulses when a sub is due. Tap to confirm the swap.

Half time — when the first half reaches zero, a modal appears. Tap Start 2nd Half to continue, or Stay and tap the game timer play button later.

Full time — all timers stop, game auto-saves to Season Stats.

Injury pause (🩺) — freezes every timer instantly. Tap Resume to continue.

Configure in Settings → 🧤 Keeper Rotation.

Enable the toggle, set the change interval, and drag players into the queue in the order you want them to keep.

A countdown bar appears on the game screen. Warnings fire at 2 min, 1 min, and 30 sec (beep + vibration). A confirmation modal appears at zero.

Tap ↺ Reset on the keeper bar to restart the timer at any time.

Tap the keeper row on the game screen to manually swap keepers outside of rotation.

🔍 sliderZoom 1× – 5×
📱 portraitToggle portrait mode (9:16)
🔄Flip front / rear camera
⏺Start recording
⏹Stop — share sheet opens to save
✕Close camera

Default mode records landscape 4K. Tap 📱 to switch to portrait 4K.

Tapping ⏹ immediately opens the iOS share sheet. Choose Save to Photos or Save to Files. If the share sheet is cancelled, a 💾 Save Clip button appears as a fallback.

iOS applies optical stabilisation automatically — no setting required.

Field playersNumber of outfield players (2–10, default 5). Goalkeeper is additional.
Disable goalkeeperRemoves keeper slot entirely — all players treated as field players.
Players per subHow many players swap at once (1–4, default 2).
Manual sub intervalWhen ON, the sub timer is disabled — you decide when to sub by tapping the swap button.
Sub intervalMinutes between automatic substitutions (1–15, default 4).
Game timeMinutes per half (10–90, default 20).

↺ Reset & New Game — clears score, all timers, and player times. Requires confirmation.

Access from Settings → 👥 Players.

✓ circleToggle player in / out of the squad
✏️Rename player
🗑Delete player (confirmation required)
➕ Add PlayerType name and tap Add

Players toggled off are excluded from the game but kept in the list for future matches.

Games are saved automatically at full time or manually via 💾 Save Game to Season in Settings.

Player stats columns

⚽Total goals
FieldTotal field time
🥅Total keeper time
GPGames played

Game history — tap any row to edit the score or delete the game. Scores show green (win), grey (draw), red (loss).

Tap ➕ Add Game to enter a past match manually.

All data is stored locally on this device — nothing is sent to a server.

Data survives app updates. Pushing a new version never clears your roster, settings, or season history.

To clear season data — use 🗑 Clear in Season Stats.

To clear everything — Safari Settings → [this site] → Clear Data.

The app works offline after the first load.

Add to Home Screen — open in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen for full-screen app mode.

Audio on iOS — tap anywhere on the screen before the game starts to unlock alert sounds.

App update + cache — if you don't see the latest changes, reload in Safari once to clear the cache.

Multiple subs — set "Players per sub" to 2+ and the swap button will rotate pairs together automatically.

Manual sub mode — great for coaching decisions: the timer stops counting and you decide when each substitution happens.
